Honestly, it depends on how you feel, and a missed night of sleep is a good reason to dial it back, not a reason to feel guilty. If you're running on fumes, skip anything heavy or technical, because your reaction time and judgment take a hit and that's when sloppy reps happen. A lighter session, a walk, or an easy run is a better use of today than grinding through a max-effort day.

If you do train, keep the weights well short of failure and stop early if it's going badly. Then go to bed at a decent hour tonight, since that's where your recovery comes from. Want me to set up something short and light for today?
